title: eriochilus dilatatus subsp. brevifolius
intro: Eriochilus dilatatus subsp. brevifolius, commonly known as the Short-leaved Bluebell, is a flowering plant native to Australia. It has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, with reported health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
